title: GTA6 PS5 DualSense Controller Pre-Orders Ruined by Scalpers
description: Pre-orders for the limited-edition GTA 6 PS5 DualSense controller are already being disrupted and ruined by scalpers, frustrating fans.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Limited-Edition PS5 Controller Pre-Orders Hit by Scalpers

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to reach fever pitch, the merchandise surrounding the title is already generating immense attention. According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Polygon, pre-orders for the limited-edition GTA 6 DualSense controller have already been disrupted and ruined by scalpers.

The DualSense controller, known for its immersive haptic feedback and adaptive triggers, has been a major selling point for the PlayStation 5. The introduction of a specially themed GTA 6 version naturally drove massive interest from both dedicated fans and hardware collectors. Unfortunately, this high demand has also made it a prime target for automated scalper bots and resellers looking to turn a quick profit.

## Fans Face Frustration in the Pre-Order Market

Reports indicate that scalpers have targeted the pre-order inventory across major retailers, utilizing bots to snap up stock almost instantly. This aggressive buying leaves genuine fans empty-handed and struggling to secure official items at retail price, while secondary marketplaces quickly get flooded with drastically marked-up listings.

While hardware scalping has unfortunately become a common hurdle for major gaming releases and limited items, the situation highlights ongoing challenges in online retail security and inventory management for high-demand collector gear.

## Editor's Take

It is disappointing to see scalpers once again ruining the excitement around a major gaming release. Retailers and manufacturers must implement better bot-prevention measures and stricter purchasing limits to ensure these limited items actually reach the fans who want to use them.
